title: Emberfall Trojan War
description: A modpack to live in a true ancient greek world, build cities, sail oceans and more!
body:
# Emberfall Trojan War

This pack is for the brave adventureres of ancient greece! It includes a bunch of new features mostly in the combat and roleplaying side of the game.

The pack is multiplayer orianted and dosent include new structures or mobs, it is made mainly for the Emberfall 200 player Trojan War event which is primarily a roleplay/worldbuilding Event, however it works great for any server!

## The modpack adds:
- Over 30 performance mods!
- New methods of traveling abroad such as ships and buffed horses
- New melee weapons such as Hammers, Great Axes, katanas and more!
- Distant horizons + Iris shader
- New coins to trade with your friends!
- New building blocks and furniture!

We hope you enjoy!
